items.title: According to the Congressional Budget Office, the US war on Iran has cost $38 billion and THE CLOCK IS TICKING— $3 billion is being added to the bill each month. Government cost estimates for wars have a history of extreme low-balling. For instance, the Bush administration initially estimated the Iraq War would cost $200 billion. It ultimately reached $5 trillion, 25 times higher than estimated. Applying that same multiple to the current conflict, if the war winds down quickly, the final direct cost for the war on Iran will likely reach at least $1 trillion.
